meta.semantics: EAX transfer-equivalence edges from strict post-call windows in full_export disasm snapshot. Window: after each call site, scan forward until EAX overwritten (mov eax/xor eax,eax/pop eax/any write incl. call/pushad), block boundary (label/jmp/jcc/ret), or 12 instructions. Copy extension: mov r2,<tracked> tracks r2 (max 2 tracked: eax + 1 copy; esp/ebp never). eax-this: mov ecx,<tracked> then call <resolved thiscall Y> (fn_takes_this|cc==thiscall|proto __thiscall) => EAX==T:Y. eax-arg: push <tracked> ordinal K among all pushes since window start, terminal call Y with CC thiscall/stdcall/cdecl (fastcall+unknown skipped) => EAX==P:Y:K. eax-ret-indirect: producer `mov reg,offset F..call reg` (<=6 back, no clobber, linear block) => EAX==RET:F. eax-ret-ds: producer `call ds:LABEL`, LABEL addr -> PE dword read -> signals function => EAX==RET:target. eax-store: mov [ebp+var_X]|[ebp-Xh],<tracked> in window; single-writer until later `mov ecx,[slot]` consumed by first call being thiscall => EAX==S:FN:var_X (S slot naming matches flow_stores/eax_via_slots). Push ordinal: args are pushed right-to-left, so P:Y:K param index of a tracked push = number of pushes AFTER it before the terminal call (last push = arg 0); pushes before the producer call sit at later indices and cannot affect K. No cross-call tracking. Entity: EAX:<FN hex>:<callsite hex> (site=producer call insn addr).
meta.determinism: sorted file iteration; dedup (eax,eq,via); no timestamps
